body:
Industrial Process Equipment Manufacturing & Skid System Projects

Project Overview

TONGYANG has extensive experience in industrial process equipment manufacturing and engineering coordination, supporting customized equipment requirements for chemical processing, industrial utilities, and associated plant systems.

This reference collection highlights different industrial equipment configurations, including modular skid-mounted packages, process vessels, piping assemblies, and multi-level steel-supported processing structures.

Project Highlights

Modular Skid-Mounted Equipment

Industrial equipment packages integrating mechanical components, process vessels, piping connections, valves, and supporting structures.

Integrated Process Equipment

Customized process equipment arrangements incorporating vertical vessels, interconnected pipelines, structural frameworks, and maintenance platforms.

Manufacturing & Engineering Coordination

Support for equipment fabrication, mechanical interfaces, quality inspection, and coordination with project engineering teams.

Project Description and Tongyang's Role

TONGYANG is actively involved in equipment-related engineering and manufacturing activities for industrial processing projects.

Our capabilities include customized vessel manufacturing, fabrication planning, material coordination, structural arrangements, and manufacturing quality assurance.

Working alongside engineering contractors and industrial project teams, TONGYANG supports the coordination of equipment manufacturing requirements and associated technical interfaces.

These references demonstrate TONGYANG's capabilities in industrial equipment fabrication and its ability to support complex processing facilities through equipment-focused project participation.
